cap_validation_design: After the failure bracket is refined, choose a candidate below the credible boundary rather than max success.
Require at least five clean closes at/near candidate before promotion.
Require no unresolved duration failure at or below candidate.
Require verified start pre-arm and durable final checkpoint on every counted validation pass.
Attach observed next-wake evidence where measurable.
Estimate close reserve from multiple observations, including upper-tail/max, not one run.
Increase safety margin if close variance is high before adding adaptive policy complexity.
Validation should include representative workload shapes near candidate.
Promotion should record confidence/count and explicit rollback rule.
Rollback should lower cap when recent clean-close reliability materially degrades.
A transient independent tool failure should not automatically trigger runtime-cap rollback.
A repeated unexplained close loss at/below cap should trigger rollback and renewed boundary investigation.
